svg.title: Homebrew.app screenshots: pending
svg.desc: Three dotted border placeholder cards, respectively indicating the Homebrew.app main interface, upgrade list and corresponding command prompt screenshots to be added. It is clearly marked as a placeholder and does not imitate or fake the real interface. Manuscript version 0.6.0, requires macOS 26 and above. Rebuild prompt: Produce a standalone native SVG infographic without HTML, scripts or remote dependencies. White background, dark blue text #203047, blue graphics #275fa4, purple distinction item tap, gray distinction not included. Width 1000 pixels, the height adjusts according to the content; labels are clearly wrapped and not cropped; Arabic text is typeset from right to left. The text language is English.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans, Noto Sans Arabic, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
